sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [LOGIC] MainShape/sh:or: The alternatives for IB, IC, II, and III can satisfy the outer sh:or even when a ship also has iceClass IA or IA Super, allowing the ship to bypass the mandatory rudder protection arrangement requirement by supplying an additional non-triggering ice-class value. Required change: Encode the IA and IA Super conditions as implications that require the arrangement whenever either value is present, rather than allowing non-triggering ice-class branches to override those obligations.
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
